`repo_root()` resolves `explicit > REBAR_ROOT > git toplevel of CWD` (per _read_llm_file_table docstring, config_readers.py:49), which is not the process CWD in the general case.
advisory.finding: Replay/ledger output paths changed from CWD-relative (`Path("docs/experiments/...")`) to repo-root-relative resolution via `evals_corpus_root` -> `_root_config.repo_root(repo_root)`. The commit claims 'no behaviour change', but when the harness is invoked from a subdirectory (CWD != repo root) the prior literals resolved against CWD whereas the new code resolves against the git toplevel/REBAR_ROOT, so artifact locations can differ for the same invocation.
